SELECT 
				COUNT(*) 
			FROM 
				(SELECT TOP 1 TASK_NAME FROM OM.OM_TASK_RUN WHERE
				TASK_NAME=UPPER('TSK_STG_EDS_CRM_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNTS')) OTR
			
				

			SELECT 
				count(*)
			FROM 
				EDS.DATE_DIM DD
			INNER JOIN
				OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR
				ON
				DD.FULLDATE='2023-09-07'
				AND 
				DD.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY=OTR.PROCESS_DATE
			INNER JOIN
				OM.OM_STATUS OS
				ON
				OS.STATUS_ID=OTR.STATUS_ID
			WHERE
				OS.STATUS<>'SUCCESSFUL'
				AND OTR.TASK_NAME='TSK_STG_EDS_CRM_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNTS'
